purpose: Move immutable catalogue membership work into content preparation while preserving generator ownership and exact results
predecessor: The shared numeric-Set index retained exact behavior but failed cross-host timing gates. Its source and complete evidence are preserved at commit 1acdd7c.
variant: Keep content-owned sparse tag postings; merge membership into bounded query-local bitmap words and visit set bits in authored order. No numeric Set or sorting; independent owner pools and random state remain unchanged.
correctness: All existing SDK tests including recorded item payloads and exact RNG/uid streams use isolated candidate outputs
Ordered pool membership matches the original for every authored base and synthetic open, explicit, empty, duplicate, reserved and excluded tags
Shared content, interleaved owners and different affinities never share mutable pools or random state
Native C++ and managed consumers retain their gameplay and ownership results
Compare empty, word-boundary, high-bit and partial-word catalogues with the original ordered-pool oracle; ensure query scratch cannot affect earlier results

timing.primary: Existing 320-command inventory course at batch 64 with a fresh logical session per sample
controls: Steady ring forging after its pool is warmed
First rare ring forge in a fresh generator
timing.policy: Both orders must pass with all samples retained. The startup control is additional; predecessor thresholds are not relaxed

memory.policy: Compare equivalent warmed owners and state, excluding separately reported content initialization. Zero tracked leaks required; this is not a device-memory budget

decision: No promotion before correctness, timing controls and memory pass. Existing milestone 43 gates and target-device requirements remain separate
